content: Assign CommunicationController to the AUTOSAR Com- munication Peripheral In order to illustrate the relationship of an Communi- cationController to the HwElement with category CommunicationCon- troller defined in the ECU Resource Description, a mapping between these two classes may be specified using the CommunicationControllerMapping (see [TPS_SYST_01014]).
